title: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man
author: James Joyce

setting.note: A Dublin boyhood grows into an artist's conscience: Stephen Dedalus moves from a Jesuit boarding school in the Kildare countryside through the schoolrooms and streets of Dublin to the strand and the university, until he resolves to leave Ireland to make himself an artist.

rights.originalWork: First published 1916. James Joyce died in 1941; the work is in the public domain in most territories. Mapped as a cited work: no text stored, no passages reproduced. The places are facts and the notes are our own.
